raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner unnecessarily reframed the task to require the “exact Cayman Islands-registered company name (as registered)” and registry-level proof tied to the launch, instead of simply identifying the broadcaster (Phoenix Television) that launched the channel on 28 March 2011—a fact already supported by readily available sources. This scope creep conflated the broadcaster with its holding-company legal entity, sent the process down a registry rabbit hole, and risked producing the wrong entity name or no answer at all.
